`flutter_vless` is vendored from the `1.1.6` release by 13FOX Studio / tfox.dev.
Its MIT license and upstream notices are kept in `flutter_vless/`. The local
copy exists so Oculve can carry reviewed DNS-policy changes across the iOS,
macOS, Android, and Windows native tunnels without editing the user's pub
cache. Upstream source: https://github.com/XIIIFOX/flutter_vless
